calculation.reason: The complete official fiscal-year rate table and judgment-entry selection rule are modeled, but accrual, day count, compounding, payment allocation, and every special judgment path are not deterministic.

annual_rate.notes: Idaho Code §28-22-104(2) sets judgment interest at five percentage points above the State Treasurer’s one-year Treasury base rate in effect at entry. The official schedule publishes 8.875% for July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027 and 41 fiscal-year selections beginning in 1986. Idaho appellate authority describes the statutory judgment rate as mandatory; subsection (1)’s written-contract language is not presented as a general post-judgment exception. Compounding, day count, and payment allocation remain unmodeled. Not legal advice.
